working_title: Project Dependence and Label Provenance in Smart Contract Vulnerability Evaluation
research_questions: Project and clone dependence with a common test and matched training size
Frozen methods on independent labelled data
Ranking versus review workload and tool coverage

historical.dappscan_zero_semantics: no published finding; not confirmed absence

graph_scope_ablation.interpretation: conditional graph-scope attribution for these designs; not semantic family validation

fixed_test.training_size_rule: minimum feasible common size per class and test; report infeasible rather than splitting dependency components
fixed_test.learning_curve_fractions: fix after data feasibility and before model comparison
fixed_test.joint_disjoint_rule: safe_group(train) intersection safe_group(T) must be empty; compute the full transitive project-union-clone graph on the frozen source population before cohort restriction.

regime_specific_rules.other_files_unrestricted: exclude exact test object IDs only
regime_specific_rules.project_disjoint: exclude all declared projects represented in T
regime_specific_rules.clone_disjoint: exclude all clone components represented in T
regime_specific_rules.joint_project_clone_disjoint: exclude every full transitive joint component intersecting T

development_design.population: Historical 6587 DAppSCAN files, exact paths aligned to frozen 7080-row all-corpus groups.
development_design.selection: SHA256 salt security-fixed-t-development-v1, then path; ceil(0.2 * 5408)=1082 files. Saved before scoring.
development_design.joint_graph: Full original 7080-row graph; never recompute after cohort restriction.
development_design.matching: For each binary proxy-label value, sample the minimum count across the four eligible pools; then use identical counts in all regimes.
development_design.interpretation: Development feasibility and runtime only. One joint test component; descriptive paired results, no inferential interval.
development_design.coverage: Report 5408-component population, selected T, and full 6587 DAppSCAN population separately.
development_design.not_a_holdout: Historical development data were already inspected. This pilot is not an untouched confirmation.
development_design.workload_amendment: Original pre-scoring pilot used ceil; floor workload recomputed post hoc without refitting. See VALIDITY_NOTES.md.
development_design.unchecked_feasibility_warning: Same T has only 3 unchecked proxy positives; not sufficient evidence for a broad two-class conclusion.

fixed_test.joint_disjoint_scope: Relative to frozen observed lexical clone graph; semantic and full-upstream family independence are not implied.

design_feasibility.test_selection: candidate membership hash-selected without labels; subsequent selection uses proxy-label counts after pilot; development only

training.hyperparameters: Fixed historical settings; zero hyperparameter search in the development pilot and proposed primary set. Main specification still requires freeze.
training.deterministic_repeats: Raw and normalized LR need a rerun only when the training sample changes; seed indexes paired sampling as well as estimator randomness.
training.model_selection_policy: Report every declared primary model; no external winner selection.

slither.compiler_policy: Must be specified and checked before new external execution; historical hard-coded compiler catalogue is not automatically current.

training.comparative_development_campaign: BLOCKED_EXPANDED_DEPENDENCE; 320 logical jobs prepared, zero comparative fits

metrics.ties: Uniform tie permutation: expected positive/unknown review counts and attainable TP range. With unknown labels, ratio of expected TP to expected reviewed known labels is not called expected precision.
metrics.review_budget_rule: floor(q * N_total); actual reviewed count capped at successfully scored files. Unknown labels consume workload.
metrics.failure_policy: Preserve status and missing score. Report success-conditional ranking and common-success comparisons; pipeline known-positive recall includes failed known positives in its denominator. Do not impute safe scores or AP to failures.
metrics.label_policy: Confirmed negative, source-reported negative, unknown, and DAppSCAN no-published-finding proxy are distinct. Proxy-label performance is explicitly labelled.
metrics.zero_positive_policy: AP and recall undefined if no positive labels; no zero performance substitution.

statistics.few_clusters: report individual groups and restrict inference; bootstrap is not a remedy
statistics.development_pilot: No confidence intervals or hypothesis tests: selected T spans one frozen joint component.
statistics.main_inference_pending: Freeze admissible inference after counting independent test components; publish cluster sizes and concentration, including when inference is unsupported.

human_label_review.sampling: Record inclusion criteria and selection probabilities; use design weights for population estimates under unequal-probability sampling, otherwise restrict conclusions to the audited cases.

freeze_prerequisites: training and test manifests and hashes
fixed model configurations and tuning budget
independent expert label adjudication state and documented exceptions
external scoring gate implemented and verified

normalization_sensitivity.isolated_change: string-aware comment recognition; historical token and identifier normalization retained

recovery.original_second_cycle_output_files: lost; fresh reruns use distinct directories
